intro: Malla Reddy University and Nizam College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded BA fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Malla Reddy University vs Nizam College is not a single winner. Malla Reddy University is recorded as a private institute, while Nizam College is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Malla Reddy University vs Nizam College for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nizam College if you want a public BA option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Malla Reddy University if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

Malla Reddy University lists B.A History, Economics and Pol Science. Nizam College lists B.A Economics, Political Science & Public Administration, B.A History, Hindi, Sanskrit, B.A Psychology, English Literature, Marketing and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹60,000 a year as total fees for Malla Reddy University's B.A History, Economics and Pol Science. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records do not hold a quotable BA programme fee for Nizam College on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Malla Reddy University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹5 lakh for B.A History, Economics and Pol Science. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for Nizam College on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Malla Reddy University on this BA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Nizam College on this BA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Nizam College is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Malla Reddy University can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
